01 / THE CHALLENGE

The challenge

Insurance preauthorization involves multiple dependencies: clinical necessity, coding rules and the next steps when a request is denied. A prototype needed to make those decision points explicit.

02 / THE APPROACH

The approach

Designed an AI-assisted preauthorization prototype connecting medical-necessity checks, coding rules and denial-appeal workflows. The focus was on translating a complex process into a coherent product flow.

03 / WHAT CHANGED

What changed

Produced a prototype covering the core decision stages. The resume does not report a production launch or approval-rate improvement, so this case study focuses on the workflow design.

03connected stages
01prototype workflow
THE TAKEAWAY

Before automating a decision, make its rules, dependencies and exception paths visible. This was prototyped before Aivana was wound down.
